principle: Go to the object containing both target and light source, turn on the light source, pick up the target, optionally relocate if needed to view under the lamp. Role precondition: target and light source must be co-located on the same movable surface such that the target is in the lamp's shadow.
title: Retrieve object under lit desk lamp
when_to_apply: When the task is 'look at X under Y' where X and Y are a light source and an object. Apply when the target is occluded initially, the nearest light source is on the same object as the target, and the target is currently in the shadow of that light source. Precondition: The light source object is a valid light object (turnable) on the same movable surface as the target object.
